name: The Mothman Prophecies
description: The Mothman Prophecies is a 1975 nonfiction book by John Keel investigating the Mothman sightings around Point Pleasant, West Virginia (1966-1967), the December 1967 Silver Bridge collapse, and associated UFO and 'ultraterrestrial' phenomena, later adapted into a 2002 film directed by Mark Pellington.
origin: Published worldwide as paranormal nonfiction; the 2002 film had global theatrical and home-media distribution.
